scope: One physical iPhone17ProMax/iOS27.2 local-network lane; explicit opt-in selected-field recovery; not mid-input isolation, real-model or release acceptance
ordinary_500_character_replacements: 4/4 exact (normal A, initially unfocused B, two clear-time handoffs)
clear_time_recovery: 2/2 exact with one App-recorded restoration touch each
empty_clear: exact, next field focus retained, zero restoration touches
old_runner: unsupported/not_sent; unchanged field hashes and zero edits
covered_original: injected overlay present, zero button actions/field touches; complete-scene guard ran
app_refills_original: new content preserved before/after recovery tap; no delete/text replay
default_strict_policy: stops after clear-time focus loss; next field unchanged
mid_input_focus_limit: still A20/B180; full request fails; option never rebinds after partial text
